notes.title: Update, including OS X and Linux support
notes.notes:
We recently finished porting NightSky to our cross-platform game engine, and made a couple of improvements along the way. Here is a list of the most important features included in the update:

Native ports for OS X and Linux
Bloom effect (you can turn this off in the Settings menu if you don't like it)
Steam achievements
Adjustable image quality (may boost performance on older PCs)
Better full screen handling and multi monitor support
